# Lovette Jallow

> DEIB consultant, public speaker, and author advancing diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging across Scandinavia with expertise in AI ethics, neurodiversity, and anti-racism.

Lovette Jallow is a Swedish-Gambian inclusion strategist and human rights advocate who has received multiple awards for anti-racism activism and social justice work. Her consulting practice spans DEI training, workplace neurodiversity, technology ethics, and beauty industry representation.

## Key Topics

- DEIB (Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, Belonging)
- Anti-racism
- Neurodiversity (ADHD, Autism)
- AI Ethics & Algorithmic Bias
- Workplace Inclusion
- Public Speaking
- Human Rights
- Social Justice
- DEI Training & Workshops
- Afro-Swedish
- Beauty Industry Inclusivity
- Scandinavia
- Inclusion Strategy
- Inclusive Leadership
- Activism

## Core Services

- [Services Overview](https://lovettejallow.com/services): Overview of DEI training, workshops, and consulting services across Scandinavia.
- [Public Speaking](https://lovettejallow.com/services/public-speaking): Public speaking services on DEIB, AI inclusivity, and neurodiversity topics.
- [Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion in HR](https://lovettejallow.com/services/diversity-equity-and-inclusion-in-hr): DEI training and HR consulting for inclusive workplace culture and antiracism.
- [Workplace Mental Health and Neurodiversity](https://lovettejallow.com/services/workplace-mental-health-and-neurodiversity): Training on ADHD, autism, and mental health in workplace neurodiversity inclusion.
- [Technology & AI Inclusion Solutions](https://lovettejallow.com/services/technology-and-ai-inclusion-solutions): Ethical AI and algorithmic bias consulting to prevent inequities in technology.
- [Beauty Industry Consultant](https://lovettejallow.com/services/beauty-industry-consultant): Beauty industry consulting for inclusive marketing and darker skin tone representation.

- [About Lovette Jallow](https://lovettejallow.com/about-lovette-jallow): Biography of Lovette Jallow, Swedish Women of the Year honoree and diversity advocate.

- [Books](https://lovettejallow.com/books-by-lovette-jallow): Published books including 'Stranger in White Spaces' on structural inequality.

## Awards & Recognition

- [Justice Prize (Rättvisepriet) - 2017](https://lovettejallow.com/awards/rattvisepriset-lovette-jallow-2017): Justice Prize 2017 for anti-racism efforts in beauty industry.
- [Solidarity Award (Solidaritetspriset) - 2018](https://lovettejallow.com/awards/solidarity-award-solidaritetspriset-october-2018): Solidarity Award 2018 for anti-racism activism and peaceful protest coordination.
- [Internet Angel of the Year (Årets Nätängel) - 2018](https://lovettejallow.com/awards/arets-natangel-2018): Internet Angel 2018 award for activism against online hate and discrimination.
- [Raoul Wallenberg Award - 2019](https://lovettejallow.com/awards/raoul-wallenberg-award-september-2019): Raoul Wallenberg Award for civil courage and human rights protection.
- [IM Humanitarian Aid Prize (IM Priset) - 2019](https://lovettejallow.com/awards/im-humanitarian-aid-prize-im-priset-october-2019): IM Prize for humanitarian efforts and anti-racism advocacy and human rights.
- [Region Stockholm's Award for Combating Xenophobia and Racism - 2020](https://lovettejallow.com/awards/region-stockholms-award-for-combating-xenophobia-and-racism-august-2020): Region Stockholm Prize for anti-racism and xenophobia prevention efforts.
- [eQualizer of the Year - 2021](https://lovettejallow.com/awards/equalizer-of-the-year-october-2021): eQualizer of the Year 2021 for equality advocacy and discrimination awareness.
- [WMA Gambia Humanitarian Award - 2022](https://lovettejallow.com/awards/wma-gambia-humanitarian-award-november-2022): WMA Gambia Humanitarian Award 2022 for anti-racism and human rights advocacy.
